patterns: APPSC asks direct single-fact items: who elects the VP (both Houses), removal resolution first in Rajya Sabha (Art. 67), President resigns to VP, PM appointed by President, PM chairs Planning Commission/NITI.
Size cap is a favourite: 91st Amdt, 15% of Lok Sabha (Union) and 15% / minimum 12 (States) - other PSCs repeat this almost verbatim.
APPSC Group-1 uses 'choose the WRONG statement' on CoM (trap: President gets discretion in National Emergency) and constitutional equality of ministers.
Records/firsts (first VP, diplomat VPs, PM succession order) and current incumbents appear as one-liners.
App MCQs are mostly 3-4 statement and 4-way match items on Article numbers and oath/resignation tables; APPSC rarely goes beyond one-line recall here.
